basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and Hearthstone enthusiast based in Northern California. I've been hooked on strategy games for as long as I can remember, with Hearthstone Arena being my current obsession. I balance my gaming life with a job in IT support, which means I'm often online during late evenings and weekends. When I'm not strategizing in Hearthstone, you might find me diving into the latest Star Wars series or discussing philosophy in Christian forums. I live with my partner and our two cats, and we love exploring local hiking trails.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science, I have a strong analytical background which I apply to my gaming strategy. My expertise in Hearthstone comes from years of gameplay, watching top streamers, and participating in online forums. I have a keen interest in learning from community insights and applying statistical analysis to improve my game.
